AUTHOR: Bürgi
TITLE: Towards a fully automated underwater census for fish assemblages in the Mediterranean Sea
REGION: French Riviera, Mediterranean Sea, France (Cap Roux no-take zone, Corniche Varoise Natura2000)
SPECIES: 19 Mediterranean fish species (e.g., Sarpa salpa, Diplodus vulgaris, Epinephelus marginatus, Mullus surmuletus, Sciaena umbra) + 'Other'
DATA: Own diver-operated GoPro transect videos: DATAT (2022, 8 locations; 13,033 images, 131 train / 47 test videos) and DATAE (Oct 2023, 64 transects, 14 sites) with paired UVC
V_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'The depth ranged from 1 to 37 m and was carried out during the whole year in 2022 (cold and warm season)'
D2: DATAT: 131 training videos / 47 independent test videos; DATAE separate 2023 campaign (64 transect videos)
D_EV: Sec. 2.2: '13,033 images (131 videos in the training set and 47 independent videos in the test set) in DATAT'
R_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'The experimental dataset (DATAE) was recorded in October 2023 in and around two protected areas'; model trained on 2022 DATAT, evaluated on DATAE presence/absence
C_EV: Sec. 3.2/Table 2: loose 0.05, balanced 0.60, strict 0.80 thresholds; Sec. 3.3: FPs 'were double checked to be correctly classified as FP'
E_EV: Sec. 3.3: Venn diagrams compare DL detections, manual video count and 'traditional UVC by scuba divers'; Table 2: 'Strict (0.80) 0.90 ... Cohens Kappa 0.69'
ARCH: YOLOv7 (selected vs Fast/Faster R-CNN, RetinaNet, YOLOv10) with UIEC2-Net colour correction; transect-wise presence/absence aggregation
METR: mAP, precision, recall, F1; transect-level accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, ROC AUC, Cohen's kappa, TSS; species richness
NOTE: Two experiments: (1) detection on DATAT video-level held-out test (precision 0.78, recall 0.60 at 0.5); (2) presence/absence on DATAE (different year, different/possibly overlapping sites) vs manual video count and diver UVC. Metrics differ between in-domain and external evaluations, so no numeric performance change -> R3 = N. Whether DATAE sites overlap DATAT locations is not stated (R2 coded 계절/시기 for different year). UVC comparison is largely qualitative (Venn diagrams, species-richness averages), but it is an independent reference -> E5 independent, E_ALL Y; verifier may judge the quantitative comparison is only with manual video (then E_ALL = P). Pretraining: COCO, then DeepFish + OzFish (class 'fish'), then fine-tuned. ENV: seagrass (Posidonia) and rocky substrates -> 혼합.
